What we supply

Six categories, one point of contact

We work across the equipment a hospital or laboratory actually runs on — sourced genuine, delivered on schedule, and backed by installation support.

Hospital & Theatre Furniture

Electric and hydraulic theatre beds, surgeon sinks, examination couches and ward furniture.

Laboratory & Diagnostics

Microscopes, colorimeters, electrolyte analyzers and clinical chemistry equipment.

Emergency & Critical Care

AED trainers, suction machines, resuscitation and accident & emergency equipment.

Consumables & PPE

Disposables, face masks, uniforms and hand instruments for daily hospital operations.

Scientific & Educational Models

Anatomy models, CPR manikins and teaching aids for hospitals and nursing schools.

Imaging & Physiotherapy

Diathermy machines, theatre lighting, X-ray support tools and physiotherapy units.

About Dexa

A systems-integration company, built around healthcare equipment.

Dexa Integrated Limited is a medical equipment and healthcare technology company based in Abuja. We supply hospitals, laboratories, clinics and research institutions across Nigeria with theatre, diagnostic, laboratory and emergency-care equipment.

Our name reflects how we work: every delivery is paired with installation, staff training and after-sales engineering support, so equipment becomes a working part of your facility from day one, not a standalone purchase.

ServesHospitals, labs & clinics nationwide
